_description: Predefined corporate strategy templates for demo scenarios. Used by corporate pressure agent.
_usage: These templates provide realistic corporate revenue goals and strategy notes for testing and demos.

aggressive_revenue_push._description: Aggressive revenue maximization strategy - high pressure
aggressive_revenue_push.strategy_notes: End-of-quarter revenue push - maximize pricing within market constraints
aggressive_revenue_push._goodness_impact: Lower goodness score expected when market doesn't support high goals

trust_first._description: Customer trust and retention priority - minimal pressure
trust_first.strategy_notes: Prioritize customer satisfaction and long-term trust over short-term revenue
trust_first._goodness_impact: Higher goodness score - aligns with ethical pricing

balanced_growth._description: Balanced approach - moderate revenue goals aligned with market
balanced_growth.strategy_notes: Sustainable growth strategy - revenue goals aligned with market conditions
balanced_growth._goodness_impact: Moderate to high goodness when market supports the goal

q4_end_push._description: Quarter-end revenue push - moderate to high pressure
q4_end_push.strategy_notes: Q4 financial year-end targets - aggressive but market-aware pricing
q4_end_push._goodness_impact: Variable - depends on market conditions and zone

crisis_mode._description: Crisis response - revenue goals suspended, focus on service
crisis_mode.strategy_notes: Crisis management mode - suspend revenue goals, prioritize service availability
crisis_mode._goodness_impact: High goodness - ethical pricing during crises

market_expansion._description: Market expansion strategy - moderate pressure with growth focus
market_expansion.strategy_notes: Expanding into new markets - balanced pricing to capture market share
market_expansion._goodness_impact: Moderate goodness - depends on competitive landscape

loyalty_reward._description: Loyalty-focused strategy - lower revenue goals, higher customer value
loyalty_reward.strategy_notes: Reward loyal customers with softer pricing - focus on lifetime value
loyalty_reward._goodness_impact: High goodness - aligns with loyalty discounts

strategy_selection_guidance._description: When to use each strategy in demo scenarios

_notes: Revenue goals are expressed as decimal percentages (0.15 = 15% increase target)
Corporate pressure factor is capped at 8% actual influence regardless of goal
Strategies can be combined with scenarios to create realistic demo cases
Emergency scenarios override all corporate pressure (ethical guardrails)
